head: 6c67844e27aac24d41ad7ccfb16c525b13412dc6
claim: The release commit publishes @byokit/accounts 0.35.1 with a FIX: changelog line for the installed Claude status probe, and that probe keeps the person's CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, so a Claude account pinned to its own config folder no longer reads signed out; the billing and provider overrides stay removed.

steps.start: An app uses an installed Claude account pinned to its own config folder; the fixture CLI records the status-probe environment.
steps: Run the existing integration proof against the parent cli.ts in an isolated scratch copy; observe the missing CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR assertion fail.
Run the same proof against release source; observe the probe keep CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and omit ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.
Capture the published accounts version, FIX changelog line, consumed changelog fragment, and dependent cascade versions.
steps.result: The integration proof fails against the parent source and passes against the release source; release metadata is captured from the commit.
